raw.overview:
Pros
- Good combined sustain between her strong shield and decent healing. 
- Increased meta relevance at C6 due to her EM and Stellar-Conduct buffs. 
- Easy build requirements with several supportive artifact set options. 
- Solid particle generation as a Cryo battery. 
 Cons
- Slower rate of Cryo application compared to other Cryo off-fielders. 
- Near nonexistent personal damage. 
 Playstyles 
 Support 
 Diona supports the team with her shield, healing, and buffs. Her Hold Skill generates a shield and Cryo Particles to battery Cryo teammates if needed. Her Burst heals and provides additional buffs at C6 within its AoE. She also applies some Cryo to help maintain Cryo auras or trigger Elemental Reactions.
 DPS 
 Diona can technically play as a Charged Shot or quickswap DPS unit. However, her low multipliers and scaling make it challenging to successfully clear endgame content with this playstyle. As such, this quick guide will only focus on her support playstyle.
 Talents 
 Level and Talent Priority
 Character Level ≥ Skill ≥ Burst
 Diona appreciates character levels to maximize her HP for survivability; however, you should prioritize your DPS units and other supports before leveling your Diona.
 Her Skill and Burst Talent levels increase the strength of her shield and healing, respectively. Diona’s shield duration maximizes at Talent Level 7.
 Her Normal Attacks do not contribute to her support role and can be left unleveled.

 Normal Attack | Kätzlein Style 
 Talent Description
 Normal Attack 
Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow. 
 Charged Attack 
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, biting frost will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged frost arrow will deal Cryo DMG. 
 Plunging Attack 
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact. 
 A lackluster set of Normal Attacks. They are occasionally needed to trigger Favonius Warbow’s passive.
 Elemental Skill
 Elemental Skill | Icy Paws 
 Talent Description
 Fires an Icy Paw that deals Cryo DMG to opponents and forms a shield on hit. 
The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Diona's Max HP, and its duration scales off the number of Icy Paws that hit their target. 
 (‍Press‍/‍Tap‍) 
Rapidly fires off 2 Icy Paws. 
 Hold 
Dashes back quickly before firing 5 Icy Paws. T
he shield created by a Hold attack will gain a 75% DMG Absorption Bonus. 
The shield has a 250% Cryo DMG Absorption Bonus, and will cause your active character to become affected by Cryo at the point of formation for a short duration. 
 Diona’s Elemental Skill can be held or tapped. You should use her Hold Skill since it provides a stronger shield, lasts longer, and has better particle generation (~4 Cryo Particles).
 Diona’s shield duration maximizes at Talent Level 7. Levels beyond that increase the Skill’s damage and the shield’s effective strength.
 For more detailed information on Diona’s Skill, please see the Diona Extended Guide .
 Elemental Burst
 Elemental Burst | Signature Mix 
 Talent Description
 Tosses out a special cold brew that deals AoE Cryo DMG and creates a Drunken Mist in an AoE. 
 Drunken Mist 
- Deals continuous Cryo DMG to opponents within the AoE. 
- Continuously regenerates the HP of characters within the AoE. 
 Diona’s Burst grants rather mediocre healing, but it provides plenty of survivability combined with her shield. With Diona’s C6, her Burst grants additional buffs to the character within its AoE.
 Her Burst applies Cryo once every 2s with standard ICD, so Diona by herself is not a reliable source of Cryo application to maintain a Cryo aura.
 Ascension 1 Passive
 Ascension 1 Passive | Cat's Tail Secret Menu 
 Talent Description
 Characters shielded by Icy Paws have their Movement SPD increased by 10% and their Stamina Consumption decreased by 10%. 
 Diona’s A1 Passive provides a minor quality-of-life buff. Reduced Stamina consumption helps characters who frequently use Charged Attacks (e.g. Hu Tao or Ayaka).
 Ascension 4 Passive
 Ascension 4 Passive | Drunkards' Farce 
 Talent Description
 Opponents who enter the AoE of Signature Mix have 10% decreased ATK for 15s. 
 Diona’s A4 Passive adds a negligible layer of survivability.
 Witch's Revelation
 Witch's Revelation Passive | Choice Treasures 
 Talent Description
 Within 20s after using the Elemental Skill Icy Paws, Diona will also fire off three Icy Paws when party members trigger Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, or Cryo Swirl reactions. Icy Paws fired this way cannot generate Elemental Particles, nor will they generate a shield upon hitting opponents. This effect can occur once every 3.5s. 
Additionally, when inside a Polestar Field, Diona will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state. 
 With Diona’s Witch’s Revelation Passive, after using her Skill, she fires additional Icy Paws when a teammate triggers Superconduct or Stellar-Conduct. This has a cooldown of 3.5s, so its main purpose is to contribute to Stellar-Conduct damage via its Cryo application or maintain 4pc Tenacity of the Millelith’s set effect.
 Constellations

 Constellation 2

 Constellation 1
 Constellation 1 | A Lingering Flavor 
 Constellation Description
 Regenerates 15 Energy for Diona after the effects of Signature Mix end. 
 Diona’s C1 effectively reduces her Burst Cost from 80 to 65, lowering her ER requirements. 
 Constellation 2
 Constellation 2 | Shaken, Not Purred 
 Constellation Description
 Increases Icy Paws' DMG by 15%, and increases its shield's DMG Absorption by 15%.
Additionally, when paws hit their targets, creates a shield for other nearby characters on the field with 50% of the Icy Paws shield's DMG Absorption for 5s. 
 Diona’s C2 increases her effective shield strength and generates a shield for teammates in Co-Op Mode. In Co-Op Mode, it may be better to use Diona’s Tap Skill instead of her Hold Skill for better shield uptime.
 Constellation 3
 Constellation 3 | A—Another Round? 
 Constellation Description
 Increases the Level of Signature Mix by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15. 
 +3 Talent levels to Diona’s Burst, boosting her healing.
 Constellation 4
 Constellation 4 | Wine Industry Slayer 
 Constellation Description
 Within the radius of Signature Mix, Diona's charge time for aimed shots is reduced by 60% 
 Diona’s C4 is insignificant in a support playstyle; however, this is the Constellation that enables Diona to play as a Charged Shot DPS.
 Constellation 5
 Constellation 5 | Double Shot, on the Rocks 
 Constellation Description
 Increases the Level of Icy Paws by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15. 
 +3 Talent levels to Diona’s Skill, boosting her shield’s DMG Absorption.
 Constellation 6
 Constellation 6 | Cat's Tail Closing Time 
 Constellation Description
 Characters within Signature Mix's radius will gain the following effects based on their HP levels: 
- The Incoming Healing Bonus is increased by 30% when HP is at, or lower than, 50%. 
- Elemental Mastery is increased by 200 when HP is above 50%. 
 Additionally, Diona's Max HP is increased by 25%.
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Characters within Signature Mix's radius deal 40% increased Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, and Cryo Swirl Reaction DMG.

Additionally, her HP increases by 25%.

Calcs for ER requirements can be found here (last updated for Version 6.7).
 Use the Energy Recharge Calculator to determine exact requirements for your team and rotation. For more details on how Favonius weapons will affect your team, please use Ac1d’s Favonius Mastersheet .
 Assumptions:
- Safe particle RNG and default enemy particles are assumed. 
- These characters always hold Favonius weapons in the calculations: Aino, Beidou, Iansan, Qiqi, Rosaria, Xilonen, Xingqiu. 
 In most teams with another Cryo character, Diona can follow the general Double Cryo ER requirements below. A few specific team compositions that use C6 Diona are noted further below with outlier ER requirements.

raw.artifactSets:
As a support with low personal damage, Diona makes great use of 4pc artifact sets that provide additional buffs to teammates.
 Hover over artifact images for more information. 
 4pc Noblesse Oblige (NO) 4pc NO is Diona’s default set for ATK-scaling DPS teammates if no one else on the team can hold it. Often, if the team has another support, they can hold 4pc NO instead and let Diona hold one of the options below. 
 4pc Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City (Scroll) 4pc Scroll is a viable option for teammates who care about Elemental DMG% buffs. While Diona cannot make full use of the 4pc set, a 12% Elemental DMG buff is better than nothing. 
 4pc Song of Days Past (SoDP) 4pc SoDP is another option if a teammate can hold 4pc NO. While Diona doesn’t have the greatest healing, she can still use it to buff on-field DPS teammates. 
 4pc Tenacity of the Millelith (TotM) 4pc TotM is only a viable option in Stellar-Conduct and Superconduct teams. 
Diona’s Witch’s Revelation Passive causes her Skill to hit enemies when teammates trigger Stellar-Conduct or Superconduct. If another teammate can hold 4pc NO, Diona usually holds 4pc TotM in such teams.
Note that 4pc TotM’s buff lasts 3s while Diona can only trigger her Witch’s Revelation Passive every 3.5s. While there is a very small gap in buff uptime, it is a non-issue in most scenarios. 
 4pc Deepwood Memories In teams with Dendro damage (direct or from Bloom-related reactions), Diona can hold 4pc Deepwood Memories. 
 4pc Instructor 4pc Instructor allows Diona to provide an additional 120 EM buff to her team at the expense of her shield strength and healing.
raw.weapons:
Diona’s most notable Bow options are listed below. However, she can benefit from any Bow that has an ER or HP% secondary stat.
 Hover over weapon images for more information. 
 4★ Favonius Warbow Favonius Warbow is Diona’s default weapon option. One copy is given for free after defeating Dvalin in the Mondstadt Archon Quest. 
It provides a healthy amount of ER for Diona and great particle generation for the team. Some CRIT Rate investment is necessary to consistently trigger its passive while Diona is on-field. 
 4★ Sacrificial Bow Sacrificial Bow improves Diona’s ability to battery Cryo teammates. In teams where Diona can take the field twice per rotation, it also allows for higher shield uptime.
Thanks to Diona’s multi-hit Skill, she consistently triggers Sacrificial Bow’s passive (>90% of the time at any refinement). 
Please note that depending on your refinement and team rotation, Diona may not be able to proc the passive every rotation. 
 5★ Elegy for the End Elegy for the End provides a nice EM and ATK% buff to the team when its passive activates. Diona also appreciates its high ER secondary stat. 
Despite this, its passive has variable uptime that is difficult to maintain. Please see the Diona Extended Guide for more information on potential issues with this Bow. 
 5★ Silvershower Heartstrings Silvershower Heartstrings maximizes Diona’s HP thanks to its secondary stat and passive. Diona can consistently maintain 2 Remedy stacks with her Skill use and Burst healing.
Please do not pull this weapon for Diona or frankly anyone. It is noted here simply if you have one available. 
 3★ Recurve Bow Recurve Bow is randomly found in chests in Mondstadt.
As one of the few Bows with an HP% secondary stat, Recurve Bow is a solid option to maximize Diona’s shield and healing.
raw.teams:
Rotation Notation
- N = Normal Attack 
- C = Charged Attack 
- A = Aimed Shot 
- P = Plunging Attack 
- E = Elemental Skill 
- tE = Tap Skill 
- hE = Hold Skill 
- Q = Elemental Burst 
- D = dash (cancel) 
- J = jump (cancel) 
- W = walk (cancel) 
- > = switch character 
- ( ) = these actions are optional; please refer to the notes below 
- [ ] = repeat these actions the specified number of times 
 Teambuilding 
- Diona slots into any team that appreciates a shield or single-ally healing. 
- She has value as a Cryo battery for units like Ayaka or Eula. 
- Diona also enables Cryo Resonance when paired with another Cryo teammate. 
- At C6, Diona becomes more relevant as an EM or Stellar-Conduct buffer. 
 Stellar-Conduct 
 C6 Diona — Sandrone — Electro — Flex 
 At C6, Diona becomes a relevant Stellar-Conduct support thanks to her EM and Stellar-Conduct DMG% buffs. She is the only character among those with Witch’s Revelation buffs who grants a reliable shield, which Sandrone appreciates.
 Notable Teammates 
Sandrone ★ As of Version Luna VIII, Sandrone is the only character who enables Stellar-Conduct. She deals great on-field damage and appreciates Diona’s shield and C6 buffs. 
 Electro
 An Electro character is required to trigger Superconduct and Stellar-Conduct. Units with consistently Electro application, strong personal damage, and buffs to Stellar-Conduct are preferred.
 Yae Miko ★ Yae Miko is the premier Electro option in Stellar-Conduct teams, especially at C1+. She provides great buffs, personal damage, and consistent Electro application. 
 C6 Beidou C6 Beidou is a solid Electro pick in Stellar-Conduct teams thanks to her personal damage (especially in multi-target scenarios) and C6 RES Shred and EM buffs. 
 Cyno Cyno can play in Stellar-Conduct Sandrone teams as a quickswap or on-field DPS. However, their synergy is limited and Cyno’s teams will be explored when there are more team options. 
 Fischl 
 Ineffa 
 Lisa 
 Raiden Shogun 
 Iansan 
 Kuki Shinobu 
 Cryo
 A third Cryo teammate can be viable, especially those that directly buff Stellar-Conduct.
Qiqi ★ Qiqi is a top-tier teammate in Stellar-Conduct teams thanks to her buffs, Cryo application, particle generation, and personal damage. 
 Escoffier ★ Escoffier provides consistent Cryo application, Cryo RES Shred, and strong personal damage. 
 Wriothesley Wriothesley can play in Stellar-Conduct Sandrone teams as an on-field DPS. However, their synergy is limited and Wriothesley’s teams will be explored when there are more team options. 
 Shenhe 
 Rosaria 
 Ganyu 
 Layla 
 Kaeya 
 Flex
 These characters grant buffs that Sandrone and the team appreciate.
Nicole 
Anemo Support 
 Xilonen 
 Zhongli 
 Example Teams 
 This is not a comprehensive list of teams. The inclusion or exclusion of any given team does not necessarily reflect its power level.
 C6 Diona — Sandrone — Yae Miko — Qiqi / Escoffier 
 This is one of Sandrone’s best team options with C6 Diona. Diona and Qiqi / Escoffier help lower each other’s ER requirements.
 Sample Rotation (Qiqi) 
Yae 3[E] > Qiqi EQ > Diona hEQ > Sandrone combo
 Sample Rotation (Escoffier) 
Yae 3[E] > Escoffier E(Q) > Diona hEQ > Sandrone combo
 C6 Diona — Sandrone — C6 Beidou — Fischl / Iansan 
 This is a more accessible Sandrone team. Fischl offers great Electro application, strong personal damage, and minor buffs, while Iansan focuses exclusively on buffing Sandrone.
 Sample Rotation (Fischl) 
Diona hEQ > Fischl Q / E > Beidou EQ > Sandrone combo
 Sample Rotation (Iansan) 
Diona hE > Iansan EQ > Diona Q > Beidou EQ > Sandrone combo
 Forward Melt 
 C6 Diona — Pyro DPS — Citlali / Rosaria / Cryo — Bennett / Flex 
 C6 Diona is a solid pick for certain Pyro DPS units. She provides a 200 EM buff, supplemental Cryo application, a shield, and 4pc artifact set buffs. While she does often take the place of an Anemo 4pc Viridescent Venerer support or Xilonen, she is still a competitive option who doesn’t require a specific enemy aura to function. Another Cryo teammate is required to enable a consistent Cryo aura; Diona cannot enable Melt by herself.
 Notable Teammates 
 Pyro DPS
 Mavuika ★ 
 Gaming ★ 
 Diluc 
 Durin 
 Arlecchino 
 Cryo
 Another Cryo teammate is required to enable a consistent Cryo aura; Diona cannot enable Melt by herself.
 Citlali ★ Citlali is the premier Cryo teammate for Forward Melt thanks to her amazing Cryo application and plethora of buffs (including 4pc Scroll and TTDS). 
 Rosaria ★ Rosaria is a strong 4-star option thanks to her consistent Cryo application and CRIT Rate buff. Her C2 is strongly recommended to allow longer Cryo application uptime. 
 C6 Kaeya 
 Lohen 
 Wriothesley 
 Flex
 Bennett ★ Bennett is often the best teammate thanks to his Flat ATK buff, 4pc artifact set buffs, and ability to activate Pyro Resonance. 
Nicole Nicole is another option who provides the Pyro DPS a slightly lower Flat ATK buff than Bennett. 
 Example Teams 
 This is not a comprehensive list of teams. The inclusion or exclusion of any given team does not necessarily reflect its power level.
 C6 Diona — Mavuika — Citlali — Bennett 
 Mavuika appreciates C6 Diona’s EM buff and additional Cryo application for more consistent Melts. For support builds: Diona holds 4pc SoDP or NO; Citlali holds 4pc Scroll; and Bennett holds 4pc NO or Instructor.
 Sample Rotation 
Mavuika E > Bennett E N1 > Diona hEQ > Bennett Q > Citlali EQ N2 > Mavuika Q combo
 C6 Diona — Gaming — Citlali / Rosaria — Bennett 
 Gaming greatly appreciates Diona’s C6 EM buff and supplemental Cryo application. For support builds: Diona holds 4pc NO, SoDP, or Scroll; Citlali holds 4pc Scroll; Rosaria holds 4pc NO or Scroll; and Bennett holds 4pc Instructor.
 Sample Rotation (Citlali) 
Diona hEQ > Bennett EQ > Citlali EQ > Gaming Q 6[EP] > (Bennett E N2)¹
 Sample Rotation (Rosaria) 
(Gaming EP)² > Diona hEQ > Bennett EQ > Rosaria EQ > Gaming Q 6[EP] > Rosaria E > Gaming E > Bennett E
¹To battery Bennett if necessary.
²First rotation only if Diona holds 4pc Scroll.
 Freeze & Mono Cryo 
 Diona — Cryo / Hydro — Flex — Flex 
 Diona’s defensive utility may seem redundant against Freezable enemies, but it is still appreciated for extra comfort. Diona is also a great battery for a Cryo DPS unit. In most teams, Diona holds 4pc NO and Favonius Warbow or Sacrificial Bow.
 Notable Teammates 
 Cryo DPS
 Cryo DPS units (except Skirk) appreciate Diona for her Cryo Particle generation that reduces their ER requirements. Characters like Skirk, Ganyu, and Kaeya can act more as a quickswap DPS in certain teams.
 Ayaka

With Escoffier, the team should only consist of Hydro and Cryo characters to maximize her RES Shred. Escoffier’s build should prioritize her personal DPS.

raw.playstyles:
Support 
 Diona supports the team with her shield, healing, and buffs. Her Hold Skill generates a shield and Cryo Particles to battery Cryo teammates if needed. Her Burst heals and provides additional buffs at C6 within its AoE. She also applies some Cryo to help maintain Cryo auras or trigger Elemental Reactions.
 DPS 
 Diona can technically play as a Charged Shot or quickswap DPS unit. However, her low multipliers and scaling make it challenging to successfully clear endgame content with this playstyle. As such, this quick guide will only focus on her support playstyle.
raw.teambuilding:

raw.flexSupport:
Diona — Flex — Flex — Flex 
 Diona can slot into any team that appreciates her shield, healing, Cryo application, or buffs associated with her C6. As a Cryo character, she can enable Cryo Resonance when paired with another Cryo character.
 Example Teams 
 This is not a comprehensive list of teams. The inclusion or exclusion of any given team does not necessarily reflect its power level.
 C6 Diona — Nefer — Lauma — Columbina / Aino 
 C6 Diona can buff EM-scaling units like Nefer, who also appreciates her shield and reduced Stamina consumption. However, Diona extends the team’s rotation due to her Burst’s 20s cooldown. This issue can be mitigated in one of two ways:
- With Columbina, Nefer can hold R5 Sacrificial Fragments. Columbina provides 3 additional Moonridge Dews every rotation, so Nefer can cast her Skill 1 additional time with Sacrificial Fragments’ passive. 
- With Aino or Columbina, Diona can use her Burst every other rotation if Nefer holds a Catalyst other than Sacrificial Fragments. 
 Diona should hold 4pc Deepwood Memories and Favonius Warbow or Sacrificial Bow for her extremely high ER requirements.
 Sample Rotation (Columbina — Nefer with Sacrificial Fragments) 
Columbina EQ > Lauma hEQ > Diona hEQ > Nefer combo 
 Sample Rotation (Aino — Nefer with Other Catalyst) 
Lauma hEQ > Aino EQ > Diona hE (Q)¹ > Nefer combo 
¹Burst every other rotation.
 C6 Diona — Raiden — Lauma — Xingqiu 
 C6 Diona only benefits the on-field character with her Burst’s AoE. As such, she can buff Hyperbloom DPS units like Raiden who can take the field while driving teammate abilities, like Xingqiu’s Burst. 
 Diona should hold 4pc Deepwood Memories in this team.
 Sample Rotation 
Raiden E > Xingqiu EDQ N1 > Lauma hEQ N1 > Diona hEQ N1 > Raiden combo 
 Limited Roster Alternatives 
 These teams are meant for newer players whose limited roster prevents them from using the teams above; as such, the teams below result in lower damage output.
 Diona — Freminet — Xingqiu — Fischl 
 Freminet appreciates Diona’s shield and Cryo Particle generation. With Diona’s Witch’s Revelation Passive, she can hold 4pc TotM in this team thanks to the Superconduct reactions, which allows Xingqiu to hold 4pc NO.
 Sample Rotation 
(Fischl E)¹ > Xingqiu EDQ N1 > Diona hE (Q)² N1 > Fischl N2 Q / E N1 > Freminet combo 
¹First rotation only
²Burst if healing is needed or Diona holds 4pc NO or SoDP.

sets.name: Noblesse Oblige
sets.note: 4pc NO is Diona’s default set for ATK-scaling DPS teammates if no one else on the team can hold it. Often, if the team has another support, they can hold 4pc NO instead and let Diona hold one of the options below.

sets.name: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City
sets.note: 4pc Scroll is a viable option for teammates who care about Elemental DMG% buffs. While Diona cannot make full use of the 4pc set, a 12% Elemental DMG buff is better than nothing.

sets.name: Song of Days Past
sets.note: 4pc SoDP is another option if a teammate can hold 4pc NO. While Diona doesn’t have the greatest healing, she can still use it to buff on-field DPS teammates.

sets.name: Tenacity of the Millelith
sets.note: 4pc TotM is only a viable option in Stellar-Conduct and Superconduct teams. Diona’s Witch’s Revelation Passive causes her Skill to hit enemies when teammates trigger Stellar-Conduct or Superconduct. If another teammate can hold 4pc NO, Diona usually holds 4pc TotM in such teams. Note that 4pc TotM’s buff lasts 3s while Diona can only trigger her Witch’s Revelation Passive every 3.5s. While there is a very small gap in buff uptime, it is a non-issue in most scenarios.

sets.name: Deepwood Memories
sets.note: In teams with Dendro damage (direct or from Bloom-related reactions), Diona can hold 4pc Deepwood Memories.

sets.name: Instructor
sets.note: 4pc Instructor allows Diona to provide an additional 120 EM buff to her team at the expense of her shield strength and healing.
